name: jt-ipam Audit and Remote Access
summary: Logins and brute force, roles and permissions, API tokens, revealed secrets, console sessions, settings and backups of jt-ipam, from its journal and its audit trail.
summary_zh: jt-ipam 的登入與暴力破解、角色與權限、API token、顯示機密、主控台工作階段、設定與備份，取自服務記錄與稽核軌跡。
notes: jt-ipam's service messages go to the systemd journal and reach Wazuh with no change on the host, through an agent that reads journald or /var/log/syslog. Wazuh's built-in FreeIPA decoder claims every program whose name contains "ipa", so before this pack every jt-ipam line ended at the FreeIPA rule 82202, level 0, with nothing decoded. Measured on one installation: about 180,000 jt-ipam lines a day, nearly all API requests and the integrations' HTTP calls; those stay at level 0.

From the journal: failed logins (web interface, second factor, phpIPAM-compatible API) are level 3 with the source address; 5 in 5 minutes from one address level 10 (each endpoint counted on its own); throttled login attempts level 6. A login accepted from that address within 10 minutes afterwards is level 12. Console connections that fail: target unreachable level 3, target rejected the credentials level 5, a RustDesk peer rejecting the password level 5 and repeated wrong RustDesk passwords level 7, SSH refused by the target level 5. A broken audit hash chain is level 12, failed anchoring level 7, a failed daily backup level 7 (measured: 28 failures in 30 days on one installation, which the built-in rule reported only as a generic service failure).

Integrations: the sync service logging in to another server over SSH as root is level 3, a write to the UCS directory through the UDM REST API level 5, and UDM refusing the integration's credentials level 5. Reading the directory (measured: about 1,500 requests a day) stays at level 0. These rules show what the integration accounts are used for; give them the least privilege that works, for example a read-only directory account when jt-ipam only reads DNS, and a dedicated non-root SSH account.

The audit trail is jt-ipam's own record of who did what. It is kept in its database and leaves it only as GELF messages (Audit forwarding in the administration area); the setup guide relays them into a file that the jt-ipam agent group reads. Then: logins with the account and the reason (success level 3, failure 5), account locked 10, a refresh token presented twice 10, second factor turned off or reset 7, recovery code used 5; accounts created 7 (administrator 10), deleted 7, administrator rights given 10, password reset by an administrator 7, account disabled 7; role membership, roles and permissions 7; API token created 10; a stored secret revealed 8; certificate export 8; full system export downloaded 10 and system import 10; stored console credentials 5.

Console sessions from the audit trail: every SSH, RDP, VNC, noVNC, BMC, RustDesk and SFTP session that connected is level 3, with the remote host, the account used on it, the jt-ipam user and the source address, and level 5 when that account is root or an administrator (measured: root SSH sessions to a domain controller with a password jt-ipam stores); file transfers through the console 5; elevation requested in a remote desktop 5; settings 5; changes to audit forwarding 10; audit maintenance (chain repair) 10.

Deliberately quiet: session ends, routine IP and device edits, scans, AI chats, the anchor heartbeat, and certificate agents fetching a renewed bundle (level 3). The journal's copies of successful logins and of console sessions starting are kept below the alert level, so one event does not alert twice. Failed logins alert in both layers, one with the source address and one with the account (measured: four failed logins in two weeks).

Limits: an audit record names the acting account by its id, not its name. Turning audit forwarding off is recorded after the change takes effect, so that record is never forwarded: the stream simply stops. jt-ipam records a console session only once it has connected; a failed attempt is only in the journal.
Active response is opt-in: blocking the source address of rules 131605, 131606 and 131609 on the jt-ipam host. See the risks below before enabling it.
notes_zh: jt-ipam 的服務訊息寫入 systemd journal，agent 只要有讀 journald 或 /var/log/syslog 就會送到 Wazuh，主機不必改設定。Wazuh 內建的 FreeIPA 解碼器會接走程式名稱中「任何位置」含 ipa 的程式，所以裝這個套件之前，jt-ipam 的每一行都停在 FreeIPA 規則 82202（level 0），什麼也沒解碼。實測一套安裝每天約 18 萬行，幾乎都是 API 請求與整合功能的 HTTP 呼叫，這些維持 level 0。

取自 journal：登入失敗（網頁介面、第二因素、phpIPAM 相容 API）為 level 3，帶來源位址；同一位址 5 分鐘內 5 次為 level 10（各端點分開計算）；登入被限流為 level 6。之後 10 分鐘內同一位址登入成功為 level 12。主控台連線失敗：目標連不到 level 3、目標拒絕帳密 level 5、RustDesk 對端拒絕密碼 level 5、一再輸錯 RustDesk 密碼 level 7、目標拒絕 SSH 登入 level 5。稽核雜湊鏈斷裂為 level 12，錨定失敗 level 7，每日備份失敗 level 7（實測一套安裝 30 天內失敗 28 次，內建規則只把它當成一般的服務失敗）。

整合功能：sync 服務以 root 透過 SSH 登入其他伺服器為 level 3，經 UDM REST API 寫入 UCS 目錄為 level 5，UDM 拒絕整合帳號的帳密為 level 5。讀取目錄（實測每天約 1,500 次請求）維持 level 0。這些規則讓人看得到整合帳號實際被拿來做什麼；請給它們夠用的最小權限，例如 jt-ipam 只讀 DNS 時用唯讀的目錄帳號，SSH 用專用的非 root 帳號。

稽核軌跡是 jt-ipam 自己記下的「誰做了什麼」。它存在資料庫裡，只會以 GELF 訊息送出（管理區的「稽核轉送」）；設定指南用一個轉送程式把它寫成檔案，由 jt-ipam agent 群組讀取。之後可看到：登入帶帳號與原因（成功 level 3、失敗 5）、帳號被鎖定 10、refresh token 被重複出示 10、第二因素被關閉或重設 7、使用復原碼登入 5；建立帳號 7（管理者 10）、刪除帳號 7、授予管理權限 10、管理者重設密碼 7、停用帳號 7；角色成員、角色與權限變更 7；建立 API token 10；顯示儲存的機密 8；匯出憑證 8；下載完整系統匯出 10、套用系統匯入 10；主控台儲存帳密的變更 5。

主控台工作階段取自稽核軌跡：每個連上的 SSH、RDP、VNC、noVNC、BMC、RustDesk、SFTP 工作階段為 level 3，帶遠端主機、在遠端使用的帳號、jt-ipam 使用者與來源位址，遠端帳號是 root 或管理者時為 level 5（實測有以 jt-ipam 儲存的密碼用 root SSH 登入網域控制站）；經主控台傳輸檔案 5；在遠端桌面要求提權 5；設定變更 5；稽核轉送設定變更 10；稽核維護（修復雜湊鏈）10。
刻意保持安靜：工作階段結束、例行的 IP 與裝置編輯、掃描、AI 對話、錨定心跳，以及憑證 agent 取回續期後的憑證包（level 3）。journal 裡登入成功與主控台開始的那一份記錄在告警等級之下，同一件事不會告警兩次。登入失敗在兩層都會告警，一筆帶來源位址、一筆帶帳號（實測兩週四次）。
限制：稽核記錄只以 id 記下執行操作的帳號，沒有名稱。關閉稽核轉送的那筆記錄是在設定生效後才寫入，所以永遠不會被轉送出去：資料流只是停了。jt-ipam 只在主控台工作階段連上之後才記錄；連線失敗只出現在 journal。
主動回應需自行啟用：在 jt-ipam 主機上封鎖觸發規則 131605、131606、131609 的來源位址。啟用前請先看下方的風險說明。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: jt-ipam
agent_group.description: The jt-ipam audit trail, which a local rsyslog relay writes to /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Check that the agent on the jt-ipam host reads the journal
setup.title_zh: 確認 jt-ipam 主機上的 agent 有讀 journal
setup.body: jt-ipam writes its service messages to the systemd journal (jt-ipam-backend, jt-ipam-sync, jt-ipam-backup). Agents installed on Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian 12 read journald by default; older installations read /var/log/syslog, where rsyslog copies the same lines. If the agent's ossec.conf has either, nothing changes. If it has neither, add the journald block below to that agent's own ossec.conf and restart the agent. Do not add it where /var/log/syslog is already read, or every line arrives twice.
setup.body_zh: jt-ipam 把服務訊息寫入 systemd journal（jt-ipam-backend、jt-ipam-sync、jt-ipam-backup）。Ubuntu 24.04、Debian 12 上安裝的 agent 預設就讀 journald；較舊的安裝讀 /var/log/syslog，rsyslog 會把同樣的內容複製過去。agent 的 ossec.conf 有其中之一就不必改。兩者都沒有時，把下面的 journald 區塊加進該 agent 自己的 ossec.conf 並重啟 agent。已經在讀 /var/log/syslog 的主機不要再加，否則每一行都會收到兩次。
setup.verify: Fail a login to jt-ipam on purpose. Expect rule 131602 (level 3) with your address on the manager.
setup.verify_zh: 故意在 jt-ipam 登入失敗一次，manager 端應出現規則 131602（level 3），帶你的位址。

setup.title: Relay the audit trail into a file
setup.title_zh: 把稽核軌跡轉寫成檔案
setup.body: jt-ipam sends its audit trail to one destination only, as GELF over UDP or TCP. Point it at a local rsyslog listener that writes each message as a syslog line (program jt-ipam-audit) to /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log and, if a collector such as Graylog received the trail before, passes every message on to it unchanged (the commented omfwd line). Run the commands below as root on the jt-ipam host: rsyslog restarts once, for a few seconds, while the journal keeps buffering; jt-ipam does not restart. Then in jt-ipam, Administration, Audit forwarding: host 127.0.0.1, port 5515, protocol UDP, format GELF. The syslog and CEF formats are not used here because they leave out the record's details (account name, reason, remote host). Without this step the pack still works from the journal, without account names, roles, permissions, tokens, secrets or sessions.
setup.body_zh: jt-ipam 只能把稽核軌跡送到一個目的地，格式為 GELF（UDP 或 TCP）。請把它指向本機的 rsyslog 監聽埠，由 rsyslog 把每則訊息以 syslog 格式（程式名稱 jt-ipam-audit）寫進 /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log；若原本有 Graylog 之類的收集端在收，也原封不動轉給它（取消 omfwd 那行的註解）。以 root 在 jt-ipam 主機上執行下列指令：rsyslog 會重啟一次，約數秒，期間 journal 會繼續暫存；jt-ipam 不會重啟。接著在 jt-ipam 的「管理 → 稽核轉送」設定：主機 127.0.0.1、埠 5515、協定 UDP、格式 GELF。不用 syslog 與 CEF 格式，因為它們不含記錄的細節（帳號名稱、原因、遠端主機）。不做這一步，套件仍可從 journal 運作，但沒有帳號名稱、角色、權限、token、機密與工作階段。
setup.code:
cat > /etc/rsyslog.d/30-jt-ipam-audit.conf <<'EOF'
# jt-ipam audit trail: GELF over UDP from 127.0.0.1, written as syslog lines
module(load="imudp")    # delete this line if imudp is already loaded
template(name="jtipam_line" type="string"
         string="%timegenerated% %$myhostname% jt-ipam-audit: %rawmsg%\n")
template(name="jtipam_gelf" type="string" string="%rawmsg%")
ruleset(name="jtipam_audit") {
  action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log" template="jtipam_line" fileCreateMode="0640")
  # Keep feeding a GELF collector that received the trail before (optional):
  # action(type="omfwd" target="<collector>" port="<gelf udp port>" protocol="udp" template="jtipam_gelf")
  stop
}
input(type="imudp" address="127.0.0.1" port="5515" ruleset="jtipam_audit")
EOF
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/jt-ipam-audit <<'EOF'
/var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log {
  daily
  rotate 14
  compress
  delaycompress
  missingok
  notifempty
  postrotate
    systemctl kill -s HUP rsyslog.service
  endscript
}
EOF
rsyslogd -N1 && systemctl restart rsyslog
setup.verify: Use Test on the Audit forwarding card, then run tail -1 /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log: a line ending in a JSON object that starts with {"version": "1.1".
setup.verify_zh: 在「稽核轉送」卡片按「測試」，再執行 tail -1 /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log：應看到一行，結尾是以 {"version": "1.1" 開頭的 JSON。

setup.title: Assign the jt-ipam host to the jt-ipam group
setup.title_zh: 把 jt-ipam 主機加入 jt-ipam 群組
setup.body: The group makes the agent read /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log. Do this after the relay above exists, then restart the agent so it opens the file.
setup.body_zh: 群組會讓 agent 讀取 /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log。請在上一步的轉寫設定好之後再做，並重啟 agent，讓它開啟這個檔案。
setup.verify: Log in to jt-ipam. Expect rule 131632 (level 3) with your account name.
setup.verify_zh: 登入 jt-ipam，manager 端應出現規則 131632（level 3），帶你的帳號名稱。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in to jt-ipam
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入 jt-ipam 失敗的位址
active_response.body: After 5 failed logins from one address in 5 minutes (rule 131606 for the web interface, 131609 for second-factor codes, 131605 for the phpIPAM-compatible API), drops all traffic from that address on the jt-ipam host for 10 minutes, with iptables or nftables. The address is the one nginx on the host saw. If jt-ipam sits behind another reverse proxy or load balancer that does not pass the client address on, that proxy is the address and the block shuts everyone out: do not enable it there. Risks: an administrator who mistypes a password repeatedly loses the web interface and SSH to the host for 10 minutes, and so does everyone behind the same NAT address (jt-ipam itself already locks the account for 15 minutes after 5 failures). Put the management networks and the host's own addresses in the manager's white_list first; local scripts that log in through 127.0.0.1 must never be blocked (127.0.0.1 is in the default white_list). When jt-ipam is reachable from outside, blocking at the perimeter firewall is better, for example the OPNsense agent's opnsense-fw command.
active_response.body_zh: 同一位址 5 分鐘內登入失敗 5 次（網頁介面為規則 131606、第二因素驗證碼為 131609、phpIPAM 相容 API 為 131605）後，在 jt-ipam 主機上以 iptables 或 nftables 封鎖該位址的所有流量 10 分鐘。位址取自主機上 nginx 看到的來源。若 jt-ipam 前面還有另一層不轉交用戶端位址的反向代理或負載平衡器，位址就會是那台代理，封鎖等於擋掉所有人：這種架構請勿啟用。風險：一再打錯密碼的管理者會有 10 分鐘連不上這台主機的網頁介面與 SSH，同一個 NAT 位址後的所有使用者也一樣（jt-ipam 本身已會在失敗 5 次後鎖定帳號 15 分鐘）。請先把管理網段與主機自己的位址加入 manager 的 white_list；經 127.0.0.1 登入的本機腳本絕不能被封鎖（127.0.0.1 在預設的 white_list 中）。若 jt-ipam 可從外部連線，在邊界防火牆封鎖更好，例如 OPNsense agent 的 opnsense-fw 指令。
